evidence.quote: The language of the programme is English.
In general, the program is taught in English.

notes: Year of the deadline is not stated on the page (DAAD edition 2026/2027, applicants from all countries); 2027 chosen as the next occurrence after today. THA page lists languages 'German, English' but says the programme is generally taught in English. Tuition 'None' is page-wide, not explicitly 'for non-EU students'. uni-assist is mentioned only for certificate evaluation (VPD), not as the application channel (application via HISinOne), so applicationChannel omitted. OMITTED: intakes (no page states the year of the deadline, only day and month; verifier requires the year; expected next deadline is 15 July 2027 per DAAD 2026/2027 edition). OMITTED: tuition 0 (DAAD says Tuition fees per semester None, but no page quote with explicit wording like no tuition fees was found). THA REQUIREMENTS: official pages used: THA programme page (FAQ and 'Your Application') and DAAD 7126. The page does not say whether a Moroccan Bac alone gives direct access or Studienkolleg/Feststellungsprüfung is needed: only that foreign diplomas need a VPD (uni-assist or Bavarian recognition office), which decides this. English B2 is required per the THA FAQ, but DAAD says 'B2 required/recommended, no proof required' (certificates only give bonus points in the aptitude assessment), so certificateRequired=false. The FAQ lists an essay and bonus points under the heading 'International Business Informatics', which looks like a copy-paste from another programme; the aptitude test itself is stated for International Information Systems.

note.fr: L'université attend un bon niveau d'anglais (environ B2 selon le CECRL) ; aucune preuve n'est exigée pour candidater : vérifiez votre niveau.
note.en: The university expects a good command of English (about B2 on the CEFR); no proof is required to apply: check your level.
note.ar: تتوقع الجامعة مستوى جيدًا في اللغة الإنجليزية (حوالي B2 حسب الإطار الأوروبي)؛ ولا يُشترط إثبات عند التقدّم: تحقّقوا من مستواكم.

evidence.quote: Please note that a good to very good command of English (at least level B2, as recommended by the CEFR) is required for this degree program.
English language skills B2 required/recommended, no proof required

note.fr: Titre de fin d'études étranger : traduction certifiée et attestation préliminaire (VPD) délivrée par uni-assist ou l'office bavarois de reconnaissance des certificats.
note.en: Foreign school-leaving certificate: certified translation and a preliminary review certificate (VPD) from uni-assist or the Bavarian certificate recognition office.
note.ar: شهادة نهاية الدراسة الأجنبية: ترجمة معتمدة وشهادة مراجعة أولية (VPD) من uni-assist أو من المكتب البافاري للاعتراف بالشهادات.

evidence.quote: If you have a foreign high school diploma, you must also submit an officially certified translation and the preliminary evaluation documentation (VPD) issued by www.uni-assist.de or the Bavarian Certificate Recognition Office.

note.fr: Procédure d'aptitude (test en ligne, CV en tableau, court essai de motivation) à passer lors de la candidature sur HISinOne.
note.en: Aptitude procedure (online test, tabular CV, short motivation essay) to complete during your application on HISinOne.
note.ar: إجراء تقييم الكفاءة (اختبار عبر الإنترنت، سيرة ذاتية في جدول، مقال تحفيزي قصير) أثناء التقدّم عبر HISinOne.

evidence.quote: We are looking for highly motivated and dedicated applicants. To this end, we use the aptitude assessment process.
